head: Medical Relief and Healthcare Services
items: To establish, maintain, and support pediatric healthcare services and facilities, including the organization of medical camps, diagnostic centers, and specialized clinics for children.
To provide financial and medical assistance for the treatment of serious and life-threatening illnesses in children belonging to underprivileged sections of society.
To facilitate early intervention programs and establish a referral mechanism with tertiary healthcare systems to ensure timely and optimal medical outcomes for neonatal and pediatric patients.

head: Education and Skill Development
items: To promote education by providing scholarships, stipends, and financial aid to deserving students, and to distribute school supplies, books, and digital learning tools to facilitate holistic development.
To establish or support diverse learning centers and vocational training institutes that focus on nurturing children into capable and responsible citizens.

head: Preventive Health and Nutrition Awareness
items: To conduct awareness programs for families regarding nutrition, childhood vaccinations, and hygiene, aimed at the prevention of diseases and the promotion of community health.
To publish or distribute educational material, journals, and digital content centered on pediatric wellness and early disease intervention.

head: Research and Professional Training
items: To encourage and fund scientific research in the field of pediatric medicine and healthcare delivery systems.
To organize seminars, workshops, and training programs for medical professionals, paramedics, and caregivers to enhance capacity building and foster innovation in child healthcare.

head: Collaborative Partnerships
items: To enter into agreements or collaborate with hospitals, schools, universities, and medical colleges both in India and abroad, to enhance the long-term healthcare infrastructure and educational well-being of children.
To undertake the activity of providing support to elderly people, orphans who are in need of Emotional, medical, Psychological and by any other needs for betterment of their health.
